pages.title: Adopting Dorito
pages.text: Dorito is an energetic ginger tabby adopting from any village for $(a)1 Emerald$(0).$(br2)Dorito specializes in surviving extreme environmental hazards, crater exploration, and sensory enhancement.

pages.title: Dorito's Paws
pages.text: Transmute in the Cube:$(br)$(bullet) Dorito + Rabbit Foot + Feather$(br2)Equip in Curios Feet slot. Converts lethal fall impact directly into hunger at half rate, guaranteeing survival from any height so long as you are fed!

pages.title: Sculk Dorito's Paws
pages.text: Transmute in the Cube:$(br)$(bullet) Dorito's Paws + Sculk Catalyst$(br2)Upgrades the paws with deep sculk dampening. Completely silences all footsteps and movement vibrations from Wardens and Sculk Shriekers while nourished.

pages.title: Night Vision Dorito
pages.text: Transmute in Cube or Craft:$(br)$(bullet) Dorito + Tinted Glass + Amethyst + Quantum Semiconductor (Jah)$(br2)Curios Head slot NVG optics. Features a tactical HUD visor, real-time ambient LUX meter, and flashing low-light warning banner. Consumes 0.01 exhaustion/tick.

pages.title: Telemetry Visor Dorito
pages.text: Transmute in Cube or Craft:$(br)$(bullet) Dorito + Tinted Glass + Amethyst + Dimensional Semiconductor (Ith)$(br2)Curios Head slot (or right-click to toggle). Full tactical environmental HUD: coordinates, compass tape ribbon, light lux & spawn risk, chunk borders & 16x16 chunk radar, in-game clock & day, and altitude.

pages.title: Scanner Visor Dorito
pages.text: Transmute in Cube or Craft:$(br)$(bullet) Dorito + Tinted Glass + Amethyst + Atomic Semiconductor (Ber)$(br2)Curios Head slot (or right-click to toggle). Projects 3D cyan targeting tags directly over living entities displaying their Name, Current Life/HP bar, and Armor rating!

pages.title: Omni-Visor Dorito
pages.text: Transmute in the Cube:$(br)$(bullet) Night Vision Dorito$(br)$(bullet) Telemetry Visor Dorito$(br)$(bullet) Scanner Visor Dorito$(br)$(bullet) Netherite Ingot$(br2)The ultimate feline sensory core! Combines all 3 visors (Green NVG, Yellow Telemetry, Cyan Scanner) into one unified HUD without hunger drain. Awards the $(6)Dorito Painting$(0)!

pages.title: Tiny Planet
pages.text: Transmute in the Cube:$(br)$(bullet) Dorito + Arrow + Fire Charge + Lodestone + Block of Gold$(br2)Right-click projects 3 orbiting celestial bodies for $(b)5 seconds$(0) (15s cooldown). Deflects all hostile projectiles, converting damage to hunger at a 1/4 rate!
